invocation: from pathlib import Path; import runpy,sys; runpy.run_path(str(Path(sys.argv[2]).parents[1]/'run-case.py'),run_name='__main__')
limits: Actual copy adapters and shared production CLI under disposable homes. Source histories and prior installs are real. The always-current verifier misses every BAD case and both UNKNOWN cases; refresh delegates to the real CLI for the GOOD multi-adapter case. Fidelity is installed files/records, not native runtime selection. Lock/no-lock/concurrency/failure/permission cases additionally exercise actual adapters in tests.
